stem.en: A toll gate on a straight highway is the reference point O. The direction past the gate is positive. A car is 15 km before the gate and has not reached it yet. What is the car's position?

feedback.en: The car has not reached the gate, so it is on the negative side of O.
Right. The car is 15 km from O, on the side opposite to the positive direction.

text.en: 15 km. The side does not matter.

feedback.en: A position needs a direction too. Without the sign, we cannot tell which side of the gate the car is on.

explanation.en: The car is 15 km from O on the negative side, so its position is -15 km.

hints.en: Which side of O is the car on: the positive side or the other side?
